description: This file defines a class `GPTImageGenerationConfig` that extends a base configuration class for image generation, specifically for OpenAI's GPT-based image generation. It includes methods for retrieving supported parameters, mapping parameters for requests, and transforming API responses into internal image response objects, along with logging call details.

classes.name: GPTImageGenerationConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for OpenAI GPT-based image generation, providing parameter support and response transformation functionalities.
